No other branch (ACCEPTED:106-110, ON_HOLD:111-115, IN_PROGRESS:116-123) renders a Decline button. Note the 'Decline' action mutates status to 'UNDER_REVIEW', not to a declined/rejected status (page.tsx:100).

(2) 'Mark complete' gated behind an uploaded 'AFTER' photo for that task — CONFIRMED (with a client-side-only caveat).
  69  const hasAfter = (uploads[c.id] ?? []).includes('AFTER');
 116  {status === 'IN_PROGRESS' && (
 117    <Button
 118      disabled={!hasAfter}

The gate is per-task (keyed by c.id in the uploads record, page.tsx:22-33) and is populated only by this session's uploads — upload mutation's onSuccess at page.tsx:59 calls addKind(prev, input.id, input.kind) (addKind defined page.tsx:24-27), with the After-photo input posting kind: 'AFTER' at page.tsx:145. UI hint confirming intent at page.tsx:151-155 ('Upload an after photo to mark this task complete.'). CAVEAT: `uploads` is React useState (page.tsx:33), not server-derived — so the button is disabled purely on client-side evidence collected in this browser session; a previously uploaded AFTER photo (or one uploaded in another session) does not re-enable it after reload, and nothing here proves server-side enforcement. Also, 'Mark complete' only renders for status === 'IN_PROGRESS' (page.tsx:116).

(3) Progress note is per-task, not one shared note — CONFIRMED.
  32  const [notes, setNotes] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});

  85  <Textarea className="mt-3" value={note}

Notes are stored in a Record keyed by complaint id, so each task row has its own independent note; there is no shared/singleton note state.

API ENDPOINTS the page calls (all via apiFetch from '@/lib/api'):
- GET /api/complaints — task list, useQuery queryKey ['worker-tasks'] (page.tsx:35-40).
- POST /api/complaints/{id}/status — all status mutations (act, page.tsx:42-50), body JSON.stringify({ status, note }).
- POST /api/complaints/{id}/media — photo uploads (upload, page.tsx:52-60), multipart FormData with fields `file` and `kind` ('BEFORE' at page.tsx:133, 'AFTER' at page.tsx:145).

IS THE NOTE SENT WITH EACH STATUS MUTATION? YES — always. The act mutationFn signature takes note?: string (page.tsx:43) and serializes it into every request body at page.tsx:47 (body: JSON.stringify({ status: input.status, note: input.note })), and all five call sites pass `note`: Accept (page.tsx:95), Decline (page.tsx:100), Start work (page.tsx:107), Resume (page.tsx:112), Mark complete (page.tsx:119). Since `note` at the call sites is `notes[c.id] ?? ''` (page.tsx:68), it is always a string and is sent even when empty (an empty string is serialized as ""); it would only be omitted from the JSON if a caller passed undefined, which no call site does."}
